item.title: Podcast: AI and wearable technology
item.description: Researcher Mark Hersam talks about nanoelectronic materials and a cerebellum-inspired design that could improve AI performance in wearable devices.

item.title: Rattlesnake blood reveals potent new antivenom compounds
item.description: Scientists found that certain proteins in rattlesnake blood can effectively neutralize venom from multiple snake species, offering a promising path for new treatments.

item.title: First direct observation of Einstein's gravity in quantum realm
item.description: Physicists have directly observed a quantum effect of gravity, testing a key idea from Einstein's theory in a new way.

item.title: New giant dinosaur species unearthed at Brazil construction site
item.description: A giant new dinosaur from Brazil, about 20 meters long and dating back 120 million years, has been identified.
